items_flat.title_en: Astra is live for Pro/Enterprise seats and in Azure Foundry; Plus still queued
items_flat.title_zh: Astra 已對 Pro／Enterprise 與 Azure Foundry 開放，Plus 仍在排隊
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said GPT-6 Astra is now available to all Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users in ChatGPT Work and Codex, and is live in the API; Plus and remaining Business seats will follow over a few days. Microsoft separately said Astra is available in Microsoft Foundry with Standard and Provisioned Throughput options. Sam Altman thanked users for patience after a messy rollout.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示 GPT-6 Astra 已對所有 Pro、Enterprise 與 Business Premium 用戶在 ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 開放，並已上線 API；Plus 與其餘 Business 席次將在數日內跟進。Microsoft 另宣布 Astra 已可在 Microsoft Foundry 以標準與預配吞吐量部署。Altman 為混亂上線向用戶致歉並感謝等待。
items_flat.analysis_en: The story has moved from launch claims to who can actually select the model. Highest-paying ChatGPT seats and cloud channels flipped first; Plus access and quota tightness remain the operational unknowns, not the model card.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 焦點已從「發表了什麼」轉成「誰選得到」。付費最高席次與雲端通路先開，Plus 時程與配額仍是營運變數，而非模型規格本身。
items_flat.quote: GPT-6 Astra is now available to all Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users in ChatGPT Work and Codex. It's also live in the API.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-6 Astra 現已對所有 Pro、Enterprise 與 Business Premium 用戶在 ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 開放，並已上線 API。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic: Claude produced the first Lean formalization of Fermat’s Last Theorem
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic：Claude 完成費馬最後定理首次 Lean 形式化證明
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said Claude, working largely autonomously over 11 days, wrote the first end-to-end computer-checked Lean proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem—about 13 million lines covering more than 29,000 intermediate theorems. The company published a science-blog account and pointed to the proof on GitHub; Kevin Buzzard is quoted as calling it an extraordinary autoformalization result.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示 Claude 在約 11 天內大致自主完成費馬最後定理首份端到端、可機器檢驗的 Lean 證明，約 1,300 萬行、涵蓋逾 2.9 萬條中間定理。公司在科學部落格說明過程並指向 GitHub；Kevin Buzzard 稱此為非凡的自動形式化成果。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a verification milestone, not a new human proof of FLT. What changes is the demonstrated scale of AI-written Lean libraries; what remains uncertain is how much human scaffolding and compute the 11-day run required outside the published narrative.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是驗證里程碑，不是人類對 FLT 的新證明。改變的是 AI 撰寫 Lean 庫的規模已被展示；仍不確定的是 11 天流程中未完整公開的人類支架與算力成本。
items_flat.quote: Last month, Claude completed the first formalized proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem... It is the largest Lean proof ever written.
items_flat.quote_zh: 上個月，Claude 完成了費馬最後定理的首份形式化證明……這是迄今最大的 Lean 證明。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI banks daily Astra resets for paid users still locked out
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 為尚未拿到 Astra 的付費用戶累積每日重置額度
items_flat.summary_en: ChatGPT/Codex lead Tibo said OpenAI will bank one reset for every day a paid ChatGPT plan lacks Astra access, with the first credit landing about three hours after the Sept. 3 post. Altman separately apologized for the messy rollout and said the company tries to make it right when it screws up.
items_flat.summary_zh: ChatGPT／Codex 負責人 Tibo 表示，付費方案每天拿不到 Astra 就會累積一次重置額度，第一筆約在 9 月 3 日貼文後三小時入帳。Altman 另為混亂上線致歉，稱出錯會設法補救。
items_flat.analysis_en: Compensating unused days is an admission that demand outran serving capacity. Credits do not by themselves confirm when remaining Plus seats flip on.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 補償未使用天數等於承認供給跟不上需求。額度本身仍無法確認剩餘 Plus 席次何時開通。
items_flat.quote: We will give one banked reset for every day you don't have access to Astra on your paid ChatGPT plan, starting today.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，付費 ChatGPT 方案每天若無法使用 Astra，我們會累積一次重置額度。

items_flat.title_en: xAI expands Grok Bot: enterprise access, marketplace templates, iPad
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 擴充 Grok Bot：企業版、模板市集與 iPad
items_flat.summary_en: xAI’s Grok Bot for Enterprise page says Grok and Cursor Enterprise customers get free usage for two weeks and can invite the whole organization. Official Bot account posts added a template marketplace, led by an in-house “Haggle Bot” procurement agent; Elon Musk amplified the templates and said Grok Bot is available on iPad.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI《Grok Bot for Enterprise》頁面寫明 Grok 與 Cursor Enterprise 客戶可免費使用兩週並邀請整個組織。官方 Bot 帳號新增模板市集，首發內部採購代理 Haggle Bot；Elon Musk 轉發模板並稱 Grok Bot 已可在 iPad 使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a distribution and workflow release, not a new Grok foundation model. The two-week free window and template marketplace matter more for adoption than any unpublished 4.7 countdown.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是通路與工作流更新，不是新的 Grok 基礎模型。兩週免費與模板市集對採用的影響，大於尚未官宣的 4.7 倒數。
items_flat.quote: Grok Bot is now available for enterprises. Grok and Cursor Enterprise customers have free usage for the next two weeks.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Bot 現已開放企業使用。Grok 與 Cursor Enterprise 客戶未來兩週可免費使用。

items_flat.title_en: Meta enables Muse Spark 1.3 max reasoning on Muse Code and Meta Model API
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 在 Muse Code 與 Meta Model API 開放 Muse Spark 1.3 max 推理
items_flat.summary_en: Meta CAIO Alexandr Wang said Muse Spark 1.3 max is now publicly released, with stronger coding and agentic results than the high and xhigh settings. @AIatMeta confirmed max reasoning is available on Muse Code and the Meta Model API.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta CAIO Alexandr Wang 宣布 Muse Spark 1.3 max 已公開推出，編碼與代理表現高於 high／xhigh 設定。@AIatMeta 確認 max 推理已可在 Muse Code 與 Meta Model API 使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This completes a flagship setting that Meta had held back for extra safety testing. Independent scores for the callable max tier, not the launch video, will decide whether 1.3 changes buyer defaults.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這補上先前因額外安全測試而暫緩的旗艦設定。能否改寫採購預設，仍取決於可實際呼叫的 max 檔獨立評分，而非發表影片。
items_flat.quote: we just publicly released Muse Spark 1.3 max!
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們剛公開推出 Muse Spark 1.3 max！

Anthropic published Claude’s first Lean formalization of Fermat’s Last Theorem. xAI pushed Grok Bot enterprise templates; Meta enabled Muse Spark 1.3 max reasoning.
brief_zh: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-6 Astra 已對 Pro、Enterprise 與 Business Premium 開放 ChatGPT Work／Codex 與 API，Plus 仍在排隊；Azure Foundry 同步供應。Anthropic 公布 Claude 以 Lean 完成費馬最後定理形式化。xAI 推 Grok Bot 企業模板，Meta 開放 Muse Spark 1.3 max。
